title: Release Scout: pocket brief & hourly telemetry roster (Apr 2026)
content:
Purpose: This is a compact, operator-friendly pocket brief for the upcoming release window. It combines a prioritized preflight checklist, an hourly 48h telemetry sampling roster (what to watch and who owns it), a short customer-impact table, and a draft of release notes to hand to Product/CS after cutover.

Scope: rollout for hosted API routing improvements + KV cache safety fix (REL-1423) across prod regions: us-west1, us-east1, europe-west1. Target window: 2026-04-20 22:00–2026-04-22 22:00 UTC (48h watch). This doc is intentionally lightweight for on-shift operators; see linked artifacts for full runbook and playbooks.

Quick status snapshot (as of last_modified):
- Feature flag: routing-v2 gate created, default OFF for 100% traffic.
- Canary in us-west1 at 5% healthy for 2h.
- KV cache safety patch applied to staging, no regressions for 72h.
- Pending: security review note from SRE (INF-2107) needs ack before broad rollout.

Preflight checklist (must be green before ramp):
- [ ] Confirm canary health metrics stable for >= 2h (error rate < 0.2%, p95 latency within guardrail). Owner: Marcus Lin.
- [ ] Smoke tests: end-to-end prompt with long-context (8k tokens) passes (no OOM/KV truncation). Owner: Evan Zhou.
- [ ] Telemetry hooks deployed: model-routing, kv-cache-hit-rate, token-cost-sampling. Owner: Priya Nair.
- [ ] Backfill fallback mapping verified (routing fallback to model-v1) and documented. Owner: Release steward.
- [ ] Customer impact list validated by CS (top 10 enterprise customers notified). Owner: Aisha Patel.
- [ ] Rollback builder script tested and located in ops-runbook. Owner: Release engineer on-call.
- [ ] KMS access confirmations for private deployments (if any changes). Owner: Security team (INF-2107 ack).

48h hourly telemetry roster (compact):
- T+0 (cutover start): assemble bridge; confirm canary at 5%; watch p50/p95/p99 latency, errors, 429s. Owner: Marcus. Channel: #prod-release + bridge.
- T+1h: verify cache-hit-rate delta <= 5% relative to baseline; check token cost per request; look for KV miss spikes. Owner: Priya.
- T+2h: customer-facing error sampling (logs) for top 3 customers; confirm no auth regressions. Owner: Evan.
- T+4h: regional replica health: us-east1 replication lag, europe-west1 ingress/egress rates. Owner: Marcus.
- T+6h: billing signal sanity check (per-route cost per 1k tokens). Owner: Finance liaison (snapshot).
- T+12h: automated anomaly scan 12h window; if any alert > severity-2, escalate to incident lead. Owner: SRE.
- T+24h: full traffic ramp review and decision checkpoint (go/no-go for 100% in next 12h). Participants: Release steward, SRE lead, Product PM.
- T+36h: customer outreach summary drafted (if any incidents). Owner: CS.
- T+48h: post-watch debrief and telemetry snapshot; capture regressions and follow-ups. Owner: Release steward.

Notes on thresholds and signals (quick reference):
- Error rate (all codes) threshold: 0.5% sustained over 5m => investigate; 1.0% => consider rollback.
- Latency: p95 increase relative to baseline > 20% sustained 10m => investigate.
- KV cache hit-rate drop > 8% across user-facing routes => rollback gate.
- Throttles/429s: any new 429 pattern appearing in previously healthy routes => immediate triage.

Customer-impact table (short):
- Feature: routing-v2 optimizations
  - Risk: misrouting edge cases for pinned customers
  - Mitigation: pinlist honored; canary + staged region ramp; immediate fallback to model-v1.
  - CS notes: notify top-10 customers that route logic will be tested; include rollback hotline.

- Feature: kv-cache safety patch
  - Risk: increased tail latency while caches rebuild
  - Mitigation: progressive warm-up, sampling of large-context requests, fallback permitted for <0.5% error.

Release notes (draft — short form for product/CS):
- Summary: Incremental routing performance and KV-cache safety improvements. Expect up to 15% improved routing efficiency for mixed-size requests. No API surface changes.
- Technical highlights: routing-v2 improves locality decisions and reduces CPU time on small token requests; kv-cache patch corrects a race condition that could, in rare cases, drop KV entries on eviction.
- Impact: No breaking changes. Short-lived latency variance possible during warm-up; see mitigation plan.
- Rollout plan: Canary (5%) → regional ramp (25% → 50%) → global (100%) with 24h checkpoints; automatic fallback to model-v1 on specified guardrail violations.
- Post-release: we'll run a quality sweep (sampled prompts + eval harness) and surface any regressions within 48h.

Known issues / open questions (notes to self):
- Q: INF-2107 security ack still pending for KMS usage in eu region. Blocker for private deployments — follow up with Security by EOD.
- Open: small number (~3) of integration tests failing in staging; unclear if flaky infra or test harness. Evan to triage.
- TODO: add a short runbook snippet into the Bridge pinned message with one-line rollback steps.

Rollback criteria (explicit):
- Immediate rollback (take routing-v2 OFF) if any of: sustained error rate > 1% for 10 minutes across global, KV-hit-rate drop > 15% for 15 minutes, or new 5xx class increase correlated to routing change.
- Soft rollback (partial throttle) if latency p95 > 35% for > 30m on user-facing routes — consult Product.

Shift handoffs and contacts:
- Release steward (primary): Aisha Patel — phone +1-555-0112, Slack @aisha.release
- Canary operator: Marcus Lin — Slack @marcusops
- Telemetry SME: Priya Nair — Slack @priya-telemetry
- On-call SRE: Evan Zhou — Slack @evan-sre
- CS escalation (enterprise): Jordan Ellis — Slack @jordan-cs

Bridge protocol & comms (short):
- Channel: #prod-release (bridge announcements only).
- Bridge format: minute-by-minute at cutover for first 30m, then hourly updates. Use the template: UTC time — signal snapshot — action (if any) — owner.
- Pager escalation: PS1 -> pager to SRE lead; PS2 -> channel + DM to steward.

Post-release tasks (48h runbook):
- 0–24h: detailed telemetry collection, annotate any outliers, collect 10 log samples per critical path. Owner: Telemetry SME.
- 24–48h: quality eval run (sampled prompts against eval harness); compile regression report for ML Eng. Owner: Applied ML.
- 48h+: postmortem if any incident, otherwise short debrief and close release ticket. Owner: Release steward.

Appendix: quick command references (placeholders)
- Rollback command (ops): 
  - ops rollback routing-v2 --region=$REGION --reason="$REASON"
- Canary health query: 
  - query: telemetry.query("service.routing.v2.health", duration=5m)

Short, informal reminders:
- Keep the bridge message concise — avoid posting raw dashboards without a TL;DR.
- If CS asks for early heads-up, send the short draft of Release Notes above; don’t overload customers with telemetry.
- Capture any odd token-cost anomalies immediately and tag with "billing-signal" for the finance sync.

End of pocket brief. Add anything quick to the slack thread #release-prep or drop a line into this doc.

-- Aisha (release steward)

Revision history:
- 2026-04-12: initial draft created.
- 2026-04-14: added telemetry roster and customer-impact table (Marcus, Priya).
- 2026-04-15: updated thresholds and rollforward timings after SRE review.
